newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LOMBARDO SET FOR CRYSTAL PALACE FROM JUVENTUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOMBARDO SET FOR CRYSTAL PALACE FROM JUVENTUS.

text.p: Crystal Palace announced on Saturday that they had agreed a 2.1 million pound ($3.5 million) deal for Juventus winger Attilio Lombardo.
The newly-promoted English premier league club said that chairman Ron Noades had met officials from the Turin team on Saturday morning and reached agreement on the transfer.

"Juventus representatives flew in to Biggin Hill airport on Saturday morning and after talks with the Palace chairman a 2.1 million sterling fee was agreed on," the south London side's official clubcall telephone service reported.
It said that the deal depended on the customary medical and on personal terms being agreed with the 31-year-old occasional Italian international.
The bald-headed Lombardo, a speedy winger who made his debut for Italy in 1990 while at Sampdoria, joined the Italian champions two seasons ago and had a year left on his contract.
He battled back from a broken leg injury in 1995 and last season put in some good performances for Juve. But new arrivals meant he faced increased competition to get a game for the Turin club.

Lombardo, who was a late call-up for Italy in the recent Tournoi de France and scored an unfortunate own goal against Brazil in a 3-3 thriller, was the fifth major transfer from Juventus since the end of the serie A season.
